subtitle: Build Relewise integrations
description: Build, review, and troubleshoot Relewise Search, Recommendations, behavioral tracking, and data integrations with current API and SDK guidance for C#, TypeScript/JavaScript, PHP, and Java.
starterPrompts: Help me add Relewise Search to this project.
Help me troubleshoot this Relewise implementation.

testCases.description: Add product search to a TypeScript application
testCases.userPrompt: I am adding Relewise product search to a TypeScript application. Show me the correct SDK types and a basic request pattern.
testCases.expectedOutput: TypeScript-specific guidance grounded in the current Relewise SDK without invented APIs.

testCases.userPrompt: How should I track product views and purchases with the Relewise .NET SDK?
testCases.expectedOutput: Current C# guidance for the relevant tracking requests and SDK types.

testCases.userPrompt: Find the Java API types and methods I should use to request product recommendations.
testCases.expectedOutput: Current Java recommendation request types and relevant methods or constructors from the code index.

testCases.userPrompt: My PHP Relewise search integration is returning no results. Help me verify the request construction and relevant SDK methods.
testCases.expectedOutput: A focused PHP troubleshooting path using current documentation and SDK entities.

testCases.userPrompt: Show me the current C# API types and constructors used to import products into Relewise.
testCases.expectedOutput: Current C# product data-integration types and constructor details from the code index.

negativeTestCases.userPrompt: Show me the top searches and revenue for my Relewise dataset last month.
negativeTestCases.expectedBehavior: Do not invoke Relewise Developer; route the task to the business-facing Relewise plugin.

negativeTestCases.userPrompt: Disable the Summer Sale merchandising rule in my Relewise dataset.
negativeTestCases.expectedBehavior: Do not invoke Relewise Developer; route the task to the business-facing Relewise plugin.

negativeTestCases.userPrompt: Help me center a div with CSS.

toolJustificationDefaults.readOnly: The tool reads fixed Relewise documentation or SDK indexes and cannot create, update, or delete external data.
toolJustificationDefaults.openWorld: The tool is limited to Relewise-controlled documentation and SDK indexes, not the open web or arbitrary external entities.
toolJustificationDefaults.destructive: The tool performs retrieval only and cannot mutate code, configuration, credentials, or user data.

demoRecording.reusePolicy: The approved 0.4 recording may be reused only when it still demonstrates every submitted workflow and the portal accepts it.
